title: Florence Nightingale
summary: Born on 12 May 1820 in Florence, Nightingale left London on 21 October 1854 with nurses for the Crimean War and reached the military hospital at Scutari, where she worked from the barrack hospital until she returned to England in August 1856. She died on 13 August 1910, aged 90. The pin marks Scutari.

uncertainty.note: Exact birth and death days given by the opened sources.

as_recorded.value: 4 November (reached Scutari, with 38 nurses; sailed 21 October 1854)

where.modern_name: Üsküdar (Scutari), Istanbul, Türkiye (the town of the military hospital where she worked; the building itself is not located on an opened page)
where.historical_name: Scutari, Ottoman Empire (British military hospital during the Crimean War)

importance.justification: Led nurses at the Scutari military hospital in the Crimean War.

reviewer_note: Victorian Web gives arrival at Scutari as 4 November 1854; the National Army Museum page opened gives only the 21 October 1854 departure and "November 1854". Identification of the Selimiye Barracks coordinate with the barrack hospital is not stated on the opened pages, so the pin is kept at 3 km (Scutari district).
